name: Catalysis: Principles & Heterogeneous Catalysis
summary: How catalysts work and are designed, with emphasis on solid catalysts that run the chemical and energy industries.

topics.name: Catalysis fundamentals: activity, selectivity and turnover frequency
Homogeneous, heterogeneous and enzymatic catalysis compared
The Sabatier principle, volcano plots and scaling relations
Catalyst preparation: impregnation, precipitation and supports
Catalyst characterization: chemisorption, TPR and in-situ spectroscopy
Catalyst deactivation: sintering, coking and poisoning
Industrial processes: ammonia synthesis, Fischer-Tropsch, fluid catalytic cracking, hydrotreating
Automotive three-way catalysts and emission control
Single-atom catalysts and computational catalyst design
